about.title: About dzLeadsFinder
about.meta_description: Meet the founder behind dzLeadsFinder — built in Algiers for Algerian businesses.
about.heading: Made by Akram in Algiers
about.narrative_line1: I’m Akram, a developer based in Algiers. I built dzLeadsFinder because I saw firsthand how hard it is for Algerian businesses to find qualified B2B leads.
about.narrative_line2: Existing tools are built for other markets — they don't understand Algerian wilayas, they don't support Arabic and French naturally, and they certainly don't cost in DZD.
about.narrative_line3: So I built this. One platform that combines multiple local data sources, respects Algerian law, and makes lead generation accessible to every business in the country.
about.narrative_line4: This is day one for Algerian B2B data. [PENDING REVIEW]

how_we_verify.title: How We Verify Data — dzLeadsFinder
how_we_verify.meta_description: Learn how dzLeadsFinder verifies business contact data from multiple Algerian sources.
how_we_verify.heading: How We Verify
how_we_verify.description: We combine multiple data sources to provide accurate, up-to-date contact information for Algerian businesses.
how_we_verify.google_places_desc: Public business listings from Google Maps — verified at least once every 30 days.
how_we_verify.el_mouchir_desc: Algerian business directory — public pages sourced with respect to rate limits.
how_we_verify.pages_jaunes_desc: Yellow pages directory for Algeria — rate limits apply to our lookups.
how_we_verify.rate_limit_note: We respect rate limits on all third-party sources to ensure fair access for everyone.
how_we_verify.cnrc_name: CNRC (Centre National du Registre du Commerce)
how_we_verify.cnrc_rationale: CNRC data is not publicly accessible in machine-readable format. We do not scrape or purchase private registries.
how_we_verify.linkedin_rationale: LinkedIn is a social network, not a business directory. We do not extract data from personal or company profiles.
how_we_verify.updates: Every record is verified at least once every 30 days.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — dzLeadsFinder
privacy.meta_description: dzLeadsFinder privacy policy — compliant with Algerian Law 18-07 on personal data protection.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.law_reference: dzLeadsFinder complies with Loi 18-07 du 10 juin 2018 relative à la protection des personnes physiques à l'égard du traitement des données à caractère personnel.
privacy.data_subject_intro: As a data subject under Law 18-07, you have the right to:
privacy.right_access: Request access to the personal data we hold about you
privacy.right_rectification: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
privacy.right_deletion: Request deletion of your data, subject to legal retention obligations
privacy.right_portability: Request a copy of your data in a portable format
privacy.response_time: We commit to responding to all data-subject requests within 30 days.
privacy.deletion_intro: You can delete your account at any time from Settings, without contacting support.
privacy.deletion_process: Deletion follows a two-step confirmation, then a 7-day grace period during which your account is frozen and can be recovered. After 7 days, deletion is permanent and irreversible.
privacy.deletion_ledger: For tax records, anonymised credit ledger rows are retained for 90 days after deletion.
privacy.anpdp_note: We are in the process of filing a declaration with ANPDP (Autorité Nationale de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel). This page will be updated once the declaration is filed. [PENDING Open Q8 confirmation]
privacy.takedown_contact: For takedown requests or privacy inquiries, contact us at

terms.title: Terms of Service — dzLeadsFinder
terms.meta_description: dzLeadsFinder terms of service — subscription terms, add-on packs, and refund policy.
terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.subscription_desc: Starter subscriptions renew automatically at 1,500 DZD per month. You may cancel at any time before the next renewal date.
terms.addon_desc: Add-on credit packs (Starter Pack, Pro Pack) are one-time purchases. They do not renew automatically. Credits never expire.
terms.norefund_desc: All subscription fees and add-on purchases are non-refundable by default. See our Refund Policy for the documented exception.
terms.usage_desc: dzLeadsFinder is intended for B2B lead generation only. You may not scrape, resell, or redistribute data obtained through the platform.

refund.title: Refund Policy — dzLeadsFinder
refund.meta_description: dzLeadsFinder refund policy — no-refund-by-default with a documented payment-error exception.
refund.heading: Refund Policy
refund.default_stance: All purchases on dzLeadsFinder are non-refundable by default. This includes Starter subscription fees and add-on credit pack purchases.
refund.exception_desc: If you experience a proven technical error on our side (e.g., duplicate charge, failed credit delivery after successful payment), you may request a refund by contacting support@dzleadsfinder.dz with documentation of the error.
refund.exception_scope: Refunds under this exception are issued at our discretion after reviewing the documented error. Credits already used will not be refunded.
